answer_summary: COF-1 has empirical formula C3H2BO. Using the printed atomic weights gives the exact carbon mass percentage 450375/8107 = 55.553842358...%, which rounds to 55.55% at two decimal places.
assumptions: The COF-1 line-angle drawing is interpreted by the standard convention: each doubly substituted phenylene linker is C6H4 and has two attachment ends.
Each boroxine ring shown in the problem is the alternating B3O3 ring with three phenyl attachment sites.
The periodic-table values printed in the problem are used exactly: C = 12.01, H = 1.008, B = 10.81, O = 16.00.
